en: This is a vintage postcard showing the Fürstliches Badelogirhaus (Princely Bath Guesthouse) in Pyrmont, Germany. The image is black and white, depicting a grand historic building with a neo-classical façade, arched windows, and a well-manicured garden entrance with steps leading up to the main doors. Below the image, there is a long German-language poem celebrating Pyrmont, its therapeutic springs, and the health benefits of staying there. On the back, the card is labeled 'POST-KARTE' in German, and has a stamp for the 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.'
